messages:
Alex C: Quick question — planning a small tweak for payments deployment rollout. Canary window next deploy, thinking to reduce replicas from 6 -> 4, and use a slow start rollout: strategy.rollingUpdate: maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0. Anyone object to that approach?

Meera S: Sounds reasonable for reducing blast radius. Do we have HPA in front of it? If HPA will scale back up during canary that's fine but worth noting.

Jordan P: HPA is enabled but scale target is CPU-based and won't react within 5-10m canary. main concern is readiness probe sensitivity — if probes fail during slow-start we effectively kill new pods and never reach desired throughput.

Alex C: Good call. I plan to bump readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 20 and periodSeconds to 5 for the canary image. Also add a preStop sleep to let in-flight requests drain:

```yaml
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  periodSeconds: 10
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
  initialDelaySeconds: 20
  periodSeconds: 5
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 12"]
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxSurge: 1
    maxUnavailable: 0
```

Meera S: That preStop duration ok? 12s might be low if downstream calls take longer. Maybe 30s? Also add PodDisruptionBudget (minAvailable: 3) while we run canary.

Jordan P: Agree on PDB. Also consider removing aggressive CPU limits for canary pods — if they get throttled they look unhealthy. Maybe keep requests but relax limits temporarily.

Sam: Quick infra note: if you're changing rollout strategy via Terraform/Helm, make sure the helm_release values override is used instead of patching k8s after deploy. CI will fail if we mutate a managed resource.

Alex C: Yep, will update charts/values/payments.yaml with the strategy block and probe overrides. Terraform change will be a values override in the helm_release. I'll include a comment in the PR about PDB and relaxed limits.

Jordan P: Small nit — for helm_release in terraform, use set_sensitive or values file? We prefer a values file checked into infra repo for auditability.

Alex C: I'll add infra/helm/values/payments-canary.yaml and point the helm_release to that in the PR. PR will include: 1) values file, 2) PDB, 3) probes, 4) note on HPA behavior.

Meera S: I can review the PR. Also ping platform-oncall if we're doing a canary during peak hours (avoid 09:00-11:00 PT).

Sam: I'll schedule the deploy for 14:30 PT then. Also leaving a reminder: update ops runbook with the preStop rationale.

deploy-bot: Canary window noted — scheduled 2024-03-22T14:30:00-07:00 for payments service (canary-size: 4 -> 4 active, traffic ramp: 10% -> 100% over 30m).

Alex C: Thanks — I'll open the PR now and tag @Meera S and @Jordan P. Will include the snippet above and the values file path.
